Coronary Artery Disease

conditions.name: Anteroseptal and Apical Wall Motion Abnormality
conditions.location: Anteroseptal and apical segments of left ventricle
conditions.notes: Systolic dysfunction in specific wall segments

dietary_restrictions.name: Limit saturated and trans fats
dietary_restrictions.reason: Prevent progression of coronary artery disease

dietary_restrictions.name: Limit fluid intake
dietary_restrictions.reason: Reduces cardiac workload in systolic dysfunction

gold_standard.annotator_notes: Cardiac imaging report (likely ECG stress test or echocardiogram) showing significant cardiac pathology. Multiple severe conditions documented: CAD in two major coronary arteries, severe systolic dysfunction (LVEF 33%), and regional wall motion abnormalities. Requires aggressive medical management and possible revascularization intervention.

annotation_instructions.conditions: List all diseases, disorders, or health conditions mentioned in the report. Include severity (low/moderate/high/critical) and any lab values or evidence.
annotation_instructions.allergens: List any known allergies or hypersensitivities. Include reaction type if mentioned.
annotation_instructions.medications: List all medications mentioned. Include dosage and frequency if available.
annotation_instructions.dietary_restrictions: List dietary restrictions or recommendations based on conditions and allergies.
certainty_levels: probable - strongly implied by test results
